meta.title: UFO Archive
meta.description:
You've grown too used to this world — nothing surprises you anymore, and the curiosity you were born with quietly fades.

USAF Project Blue Book (1947–1969, 12,618 cases), France's GEIPAN, the UK MoD DEFE 24 series, Brazil's National Archives, and NUFORC's 160,000+ civilian reports — one place to search them all. Ask by country, year, shape or keyword; records of the same event are merged and every official explanation is attributed to its source. What you look up is filed into your own archive page, ready to browse anytime.
